description: Find UK clinics that prescribe cannabis-based medicines, nearest first with `near`, filtered by condition, consultation type, CQC rating, fee or patient type. Returns fees, year-one cost and CQC rating; not doctors or appointments. Example: {"near":"Leeds","consultationType":"ONLINE"}

condition.description: A condition the clinic's policy lists, e.g. "chronic pain", "PTSD".

near.description: UK postcode or town; nearest first.

page.description: 60-row window; the answer says when there is another.

patientType.description: Clinics taking this patient type; prices year one for it.

sort.description: cheapest/dearest = year-one clinic fees. Default distance with `near`, else az.

name: find_clinics

directoryTotal.description: The whole directory, when the tool read one window of it

page.description: Which window of 60 directory rows this answer read

acceptingPatients.description: Shows 'Accepting patients' (an active published eligibility policy)

distanceMiles.description: Miles from `near`; null when no place was given

firstYearClinicFees.description: Estimated year-one clinic fees (consultations, membership, the clinic's prescription fee) for the asked patient type with 4 follow-ups and 12 prescriptions; never includes medicine; null when no price list is published

patientTypes.description: Patient types the published policy takes; null when the clinic publishes no policy

rating.description: Published patient reviews; null when there are none

url.description: Canonical Findabis page, absolute; null when the listing has no page

total.description: How many matched in all; narrow the query when this exceeds the results

title: Find medical cannabis clinics
